messages.subject: Project Yarrow — LTSA counter-draft (Halstead)
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair, Nadia,

Our counter-draft is attached (tracked over your mark-up). Headlines: liability cap landed at 135%; delay-termination trigger countered to 6 weeks; we've accepted your 20% shortfall and the certification-delay relief (bounded to one contract year). We've also added an escalation cap of 5% and a carbon-fibre materials pass-through that only applies above a 10% annual index move — this reflects Halstead's input-cost exposure.

We think this is close. Shall we aim to settle on a call next week?

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
